title: Fewer creatures, the whole height
lede: The deep's creatures are fewer and spread over the whole water.
head: f022627e5ac859eabd9af5262db198546d39e0fe

items.title: Fewer creatures, the whole height
items.what: The serpent's meal fish come half as often and swim the whole height, far crossings are rarer, and the three roamers start spread top to bottom.
